accounts_credential_only.name: accounts_credential_only
accounts_credential_only.value:
"accounts"."provider_id" = 'credential' and "accounts"."password" is not null
        and "accounts"."access_token" is null and "accounts"."refresh_token" is null and "accounts"."id_token" is null
        and "accounts"."access_token_expires_at" is null and "accounts"."refresh_token_expires_at" is null
        and "accounts"."scope" is null

memberships_archived_with_reason.name: memberships_archived_with_reason
memberships_archived_with_reason.value:
("memberships"."archived_at" is null) = ("memberships"."archived_reason" is null)
        and ("memberships"."archived_reason" is null or char_length("memberships"."archived_reason") between 1 and 1000)

api_client_keys_revocation.name: api_client_keys_revocation
api_client_keys_revocation.value:
("api_client_keys"."revoked_at" is null) = ("api_client_keys"."revoke_reason" is null)
        and ("api_client_keys"."revoked_at" is null) = ("api_client_keys"."revoked_by_user_id" is null)
        and ("api_client_keys"."revoke_reason" is null or char_length("api_client_keys"."revoke_reason") between 1 and 500)

api_clients_scopes.name: api_clients_scopes
api_clients_scopes.value:
cardinality("api_clients"."scopes") between 1 and 3
        and "api_clients"."scopes" <@ array['events:write', 'periods:read', 'reconciliation:write']::text[]
        and array_position("api_clients"."scopes", null) is null

audit_entries_actor.name: audit_entries_actor
audit_entries_actor.value:
("audit_entries"."actor_kind" = 'person' and "audit_entries"."actor_user_id" is not null and "audit_entries"."actor_api_client_id" is null)
        or ("audit_entries"."actor_kind" = 'api_client' and "audit_entries"."actor_api_client_id" is not null and "audit_entries"."actor_user_id" is null)
        or ("audit_entries"."actor_kind" = 'system' and "audit_entries"."actor_user_id" is null and "audit_entries"."actor_api_client_id" is null)

chart_accounts_code_shape.name: chart_accounts_code_shape
chart_accounts_code_shape.value:
("chart_accounts"."level" = 1 and "chart_accounts"."code" ~ '^[1-5]$')
        or ("chart_accounts"."level" = 2 and "chart_accounts"."code" ~ '^[1-5][1-9]$')
        or ("chart_accounts"."level" = 3 and "chart_accounts"."code" ~ '^[1-5][1-9][1-9]$')
        or ("chart_accounts"."level" = 4 and "chart_accounts"."code" ~ '^[1-5][1-9][1-9][0-9]{3}$' and right("chart_accounts"."code", 3) <> '000')

chart_accounts_class_of_code.name: chart_accounts_class_of_code
chart_accounts_class_of_code.value:
("chart_accounts"."class" = case left("chart_accounts"."code", 1) when '1' then 'asset' when '2' then 'liability'
        when '3' then 'equity' when '4' then 'revenue' when '5' then 'expense' end) is true

chart_accounts_statement_line.name: chart_accounts_statement_line
chart_accounts_statement_line.value:
("chart_accounts"."kind" = 'postable') = ("chart_accounts"."statement_line" is not null)
        and ("chart_accounts"."statement_line" is null
          or ("chart_accounts"."class" in ('asset', 'liability', 'equity')
            and "chart_accounts"."statement_line" in ('bs.cash', 'bs.trade_receivables', 'bs.contract_assets', 'bs.other_current_assets', 'bs.ppe', 'bs.trade_payables', 'bs.contract_liabilities', 'bs.client_money', 'bs.tax_liabilities', 'bs.accruals', 'bs.share_capital', 'bs.retained_earnings', 'bs.owner_current'))
          or ("chart_accounts"."class" in ('revenue', 'expense')
            and "chart_accounts"."statement_line" in ('is.revenue', 'is.other_income', 'is.direct_costs', 'is.employee_benefits', 'is.depreciation', 'is.other_expenses', 'is.fx_differences', 'is.finance_costs', 'is.income_tax')))

chart_accounts_flags.name: chart_accounts_flags
chart_accounts_flags.value:
(not ("chart_accounts"."is_control" or "chart_accounts"."is_monetary") or "chart_accounts"."class" in ('asset', 'liability'))
        and ("chart_accounts"."kind" = 'postable' or (not "chart_accounts"."is_control" and not "chart_accounts"."is_monetary" and "chart_accounts"."currency" is null))

chart_accounts_item_kind.name: chart_accounts_item_kind
chart_accounts_item_kind.value:
("chart_accounts"."is_control" = ("chart_accounts"."item_kind" is not null))
        and ("chart_accounts"."item_kind" is null or "chart_accounts"."item_kind" in ('document', 'running'))

chart_accounts_postable_states.name: chart_accounts_postable_states
chart_accounts_postable_states.value: "chart_accounts"."kind" = 'postable' or ("chart_accounts"."blocked_at" is null and "chart_accounts"."first_posted_at" is null)

chart_accounts_blocked_with_reason.name: chart_accounts_blocked_with_reason
chart_accounts_blocked_with_reason.value:
("chart_accounts"."blocked_at" is null) = ("chart_accounts"."blocked_reason" is null)
        and ("chart_accounts"."blocked_reason" is null or char_length("chart_accounts"."blocked_reason") between 1 and 1000)

chart_accounts_archived_with_reason.name: chart_accounts_archived_with_reason
chart_accounts_archived_with_reason.value:
("chart_accounts"."archived_at" is null) = ("chart_accounts"."archived_reason" is null)
        and ("chart_accounts"."archived_reason" is null or char_length("chart_accounts"."archived_reason") between 1 and 1000)

companies_name_latin_length.name: companies_name_latin_length
companies_name_latin_length.value: "companies"."name_latin" is null or char_length("companies"."name_latin") between 1 and 200

companies_archived_with_reason.name: companies_archived_with_reason
companies_archived_with_reason.value:
("companies"."archived_at" is null) = ("companies"."archived_reason" is null)
        and ("companies"."archived_reason" is null or char_length("companies"."archived_reason") between 1 and 1000)

company_settings_currencies.name: company_settings_currencies
company_settings_currencies.value:
"company_settings"."book_currency" in ('USD', 'SYP', 'TRY', 'EUR')
        and ("company_settings"."parallel_currency" is null or "company_settings"."parallel_currency" in ('USD', 'SYP', 'TRY', 'EUR'))

company_settings_rate_types.name: company_settings_rate_types
company_settings_rate_types.value:
"company_settings"."book_rate_type" in ('market', 'bulletin')
        and ("company_settings"."parallel_rate_type" is null or "company_settings"."parallel_rate_type" in ('market', 'bulletin'))

company_settings_parallel_complete.name: company_settings_parallel_complete
company_settings_parallel_complete.value:
("company_settings"."parallel_currency" is null) = ("company_settings"."parallel_rate_type" is null)
        and ("company_settings"."parallel_currency" is null) = ("company_settings"."parallel_accepts_transaction_rate" is null)

company_settings_transaction_rate_market.name: company_settings_transaction_rate_market_only
company_settings_transaction_rate_market.value:
(not "company_settings"."book_accepts_transaction_rate" or "company_settings"."book_rate_type" = 'market')
        and ("company_settings"."parallel_accepts_transaction_rate" is not true or "company_settings"."parallel_rate_type" = 'market')

dimension_values_code_length.name: dimension_values_code_length
dimension_values_code_length.value: "dimension_values"."code" is null or char_length("dimension_values"."code") between 1 and 40

dimension_values_external.name: dimension_values_external
dimension_values_external.value:
("dimension_values"."external_source" is null) = ("dimension_values"."external_id" is null)
        and ("dimension_values"."external_source" is null or "dimension_values"."external_source" in ('hub'))
        and ("dimension_values"."external_id" is null or char_length("dimension_values"."external_id") between 1 and 100)

entry_attachments_owner.name: entry_attachments_owner
entry_attachments_owner.value: "entry_attachments"."draft_id" is not null or "entry_attachments"."entry_id" is not null

entry_attachments_archived.name: entry_attachments_archived
entry_attachments_archived.value:
("entry_attachments"."archived_at" is not null or "entry_attachments"."archived_reason" is null)
        and ("entry_attachments"."archived_reason" is null or char_length("entry_attachments"."archived_reason") between 1 and 1000)

entry_draft_lines_item.name: entry_draft_lines_item
entry_draft_lines_item.value:
("entry_draft_lines"."open_item_id" is null or "entry_draft_lines"."new_item_reference" is null)
        and ("entry_draft_lines"."new_item_due_on" is null or "entry_draft_lines"."new_item_reference" is not null)

entry_draft_lines_memo_length.name: entry_draft_lines_memo_length
entry_draft_lines_memo_length.value: "entry_draft_lines"."memo" is null or char_length("entry_draft_lines"."memo") between 1 and 300

entry_drafts_description_length.name: entry_drafts_description_length
entry_drafts_description_length.value: "entry_drafts"."description" is null or char_length("entry_drafts"."description") between 1 and 500

entry_drafts_reference_length.name: entry_drafts_reference_length
entry_drafts_reference_length.value: "entry_drafts"."reference" is null or char_length("entry_drafts"."reference") between 1 and 100

entry_drafts_submitted.name: entry_drafts_submitted
entry_drafts_submitted.value:
("entry_drafts"."submitted_by_user_id" is null) = ("entry_drafts"."submitted_at" is null)
        and ("entry_drafts"."state" <> 'submitted' or "entry_drafts"."submitted_by_user_id" is not null)

entry_drafts_rejected.name: entry_drafts_rejected
entry_drafts_rejected.value:
("entry_drafts"."rejected_by_user_id" is null) = ("entry_drafts"."rejected_reason" is null)
        and ("entry_drafts"."rejected_reason" is null) = ("entry_drafts"."rejected_at" is null)
        and ("entry_drafts"."rejected_reason" is null or char_length("entry_drafts"."rejected_reason") between 1 and 1000)

entry_drafts_archived.name: entry_drafts_archived
entry_drafts_archived.value:
("entry_drafts"."archived_at" is null or "entry_drafts"."state" = 'draft')
        and ("entry_drafts"."archived_at" is not null or "entry_drafts"."archived_reason" is null)
        and ("entry_drafts"."archived_reason" is null or char_length("entry_drafts"."archived_reason") between 1 and 1000)

email_outbox_sent_with_key.name: email_outbox_sent_with_key
email_outbox_sent_with_key.value: "email_outbox"."sent_at" is null or "email_outbox"."dedupe_key" is not null

email_outbox_dedupe_key_length.name: email_outbox_dedupe_key_length
email_outbox_dedupe_key_length.value: "email_outbox"."dedupe_key" is null or char_length("email_outbox"."dedupe_key") between 1 and 200

inbound_event_actions_hold.name: inbound_event_actions_hold
inbound_event_actions_hold.value:
("inbound_event_actions"."hold_reason" is null or "inbound_event_actions"."hold_reason" in ('PERIOD_CLOSED', 'SERVICE_PERIOD_CLOSED', 'UNKNOWN_REFERENCE', 'NO_MAPPING', 'RATE_MISSING', 'NEEDS_DECISION', 'OPEN_ITEM_HAS_SETTLEMENTS', 'WAITING_FOR_EARLIER_EVENT'))
        and ("inbound_event_actions"."hold_detail" is null or "inbound_event_actions"."hold_reason" is not null)

inbound_event_actions_actor.name: inbound_event_actions_actor
inbound_event_actions_actor.value:
("inbound_event_actions"."actor_kind" = 'person' and "inbound_event_actions"."actor_user_id" is not null and "inbound_event_actions"."actor_api_client_id" is null)
        or ("inbound_event_actions"."actor_kind" = 'api_client' and "inbound_event_actions"."actor_api_client_id" is not null and "inbound_event_actions"."actor_user_id" is null)
        or ("inbound_event_actions"."actor_kind" = 'system' and "inbound_event_actions"."actor_user_id" is null and "inbound_event_actions"."actor_api_client_id" is null)

inbound_event_actions_reason.name: inbound_event_actions_reason
inbound_event_actions_reason.value:
("inbound_event_actions"."reason" is null or char_length("inbound_event_actions"."reason") between 1 and 500)
        and ("inbound_event_actions"."action" not in ('moved_to_open_period', 'resolved', 'dismissed', 'recognised_in_open_period', 'remainder_split') or "inbound_event_actions"."reason" is not null)

inbound_event_states_hold.name: inbound_event_states_hold
inbound_event_states_hold.value:
("inbound_event_states"."state" = 'held') = ("inbound_event_states"."hold_reason" is not null)
        and ("inbound_event_states"."hold_reason" is null or "inbound_event_states"."hold_reason" in ('PERIOD_CLOSED', 'SERVICE_PERIOD_CLOSED', 'UNKNOWN_REFERENCE', 'NO_MAPPING', 'RATE_MISSING', 'NEEDS_DECISION', 'OPEN_ITEM_HAS_SETTLEMENTS', 'WAITING_FOR_EARLIER_EVENT'))
        and ("inbound_event_states"."hold_detail" is null or ("inbound_event_states"."hold_reason" is not null
          and "inbound_event_states"."hold_detail" ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*(:[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,60})?$'))
        and ("inbound_event_states"."hold_reason" = 'WAITING_FOR_EARLIER_EVENT') = ("inbound_event_states"."waiting_for_event_id" is not null)
        and ("inbound_event_states"."waiting_for_event_id" is null or "inbound_event_states"."waiting_for_event_id" <> "inbound_event_states"."event_id")

inbound_event_states_outcome.name: inbound_event_states_outcome
inbound_event_states_outcome.value:
("inbound_event_states"."state" = 'resolved') = ("inbound_event_states"."resolved_by_entry_id" is not null)
        and ("inbound_event_states"."posted_on" is null or "inbound_event_states"."state" = 'posted')

inbound_events_document.name: inbound_events_document
inbound_events_document.value:
char_length("inbound_events"."document_type") between 1 and 40
        and char_length("inbound_events"."document_id") between 1 and 100
        and ("inbound_events"."document_number" is null or char_length("inbound_events"."document_number") between 1 and 100)
        and ("inbound_events"."item_key" is null or char_length("inbound_events"."item_key") between 1 and 200)

posting_rule_accounts_currency.name: posting_rule_accounts_currency
posting_rule_accounts_currency.value:
("posting_rule_accounts"."slot"::text like 'payment_method.%') = ("posting_rule_accounts"."currency" is not null)
        and ("posting_rule_accounts"."currency" is null or "posting_rule_accounts"."currency" in ('SYP', 'USD'))

journal_entries_posted_by.name: journal_entries_posted_by
journal_entries_posted_by.value:
("journal_entries"."posted_by_user_id" is null or "journal_entries"."posted_by_client_id" is null)
        and ("journal_entries"."source" <> 'manual' or "journal_entries"."posted_by_user_id" is not null)

journal_entries_hashes.name: journal_entries_hashes
journal_entries_hashes.value:
"journal_entries"."hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
        and ("journal_entries"."previous_hash" is null or "journal_entries"."previous_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
        and ("journal_entries"."sequence" = 1) = ("journal_entries"."previous_hash" is null)

journal_lines_ledger.name: journal_lines_ledger
journal_lines_ledger.value:
("journal_lines"."ledger" is not null) = ("journal_lines"."kind" in ('difference', 'rounding'))
        and ("journal_lines"."ledger" is null or "journal_lines"."ledger" in ('book', 'parallel'))

journal_lines_one_ledger.name: journal_lines_one_ledger
journal_lines_one_ledger.value:
"journal_lines"."ledger" is null
        or ("journal_lines"."ledger" = 'book' and coalesce("journal_lines"."parallel_minor", 0) = 0)
        or ("journal_lines"."ledger" = 'parallel' and "journal_lines"."book_minor" = 0 and "journal_lines"."parallel_minor" is not null)

journal_lines_memo_length.name: journal_lines_memo_length
journal_lines_memo_length.value: "journal_lines"."memo" is null or char_length("journal_lines"."memo") between 1 and 300

ledger_heads_state.name: ledger_heads_state
ledger_heads_state.value:
"ledger_heads"."entry_count" >= 0
        and ("ledger_heads"."entry_count" = 0) = ("ledger_heads"."last_entry_id" is null)
        and ("ledger_heads"."entry_count" = 0) = ("ledger_heads"."last_hash" is null)
        and ("ledger_heads"."last_hash" is null or "ledger_heads"."last_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

line_conversions_basis.name: line_conversions_basis
line_conversions_basis.value:
"line_conversions"."basis" in ('policy', 'transaction')
        and ("line_conversions"."rate_id" is null) = ("line_conversions"."basis" = 'transaction')
        and ("line_conversions"."basis" = 'policy' or "line_conversions"."quote_no" = 1)

period_balances_totals.name: period_balances_totals
period_balances_totals.value:
"period_balances"."debit_minor" >= 0 and "period_balances"."credit_minor" >= 0
        and "period_balances"."book_debit_minor" >= 0 and "period_balances"."book_credit_minor" >= 0
        and ("period_balances"."parallel_debit_minor" is null) = ("period_balances"."parallel_credit_minor" is null)
        and coalesce("period_balances"."parallel_debit_minor", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("period_balances"."parallel_credit_minor", 0) >= 0
        and "period_balances"."line_count" >= 1

period_events_checklist.name: period_events_checklist
period_events_checklist.value:
("period_events"."kind" = 'closed') = ("period_events"."checklist" is not null)
        and ("period_events"."checklist" is null or jsonb_typeof("period_events"."checklist") = 'array')

open_item_due_dates_user.name: open_item_due_dates_user
open_item_due_dates_user.value:
("open_item_due_dates"."set_by" = 'user') = ("open_item_due_dates"."user_id" is not null)
        and ("open_item_due_dates"."set_by" <> 'user' or "open_item_due_dates"."reason" is not null)

open_items_hub_document.name: open_items_hub_document
open_items_hub_document.value:
"open_items"."hub_document" is null
        or ("open_items"."source" in ('hub_event', 'opening') and jsonb_typeof("open_items"."hub_document") = 'object')

exchange_rates_correction_reason.name: exchange_rates_correction_reason
exchange_rates_correction_reason.value:
("exchange_rates"."supersedes_rate_id" is null) = ("exchange_rates"."reason" is null)
        and ("exchange_rates"."reason" is null or char_length("exchange_rates"."reason") between 1 and 500)

recognition_movements_month.name: recognition_movements_month
recognition_movements_month.value:
("recognition_movements"."month" is null or extract(day from "recognition_movements"."month") = 1)
        and ("recognition_movements"."kind" not in ('elapsed', 'adjusted') or "recognition_movements"."month" is not null)

recognition_movements_entry.name: recognition_movements_entry
recognition_movements_entry.value:
"recognition_movements"."entry_id" is not null
        or ("recognition_movements"."kind" = 'reclassified' and "recognition_movements"."transaction_minor" = 0 and "recognition_movements"."book_minor" = 0
          and coalesce("recognition_movements"."parallel_minor", 0) = 0)

recognition_movements_credit.name: recognition_movements_credit
recognition_movements_credit.value:
("recognition_movements"."kind" = 'credited') = ("recognition_movements"."credit_minor" is not null)
        and ("recognition_movements"."credit_minor" is null or "recognition_movements"."credit_minor" <> 0)

recognition_schedules_charge_kind.name: recognition_schedules_charge_kind
recognition_schedules_charge_kind.value:
("recognition_schedules"."line_source" = 'retainer_charge') = ("recognition_schedules"."charge_kind" is not null)
        and ("recognition_schedules"."charge_kind" is null or "recognition_schedules"."charge_kind" in ('monthly', 'addition'))

recognition_schedules_pattern_fields.name: recognition_schedules_pattern_fields
recognition_schedules_pattern_fields.value:
("recognition_schedules"."pattern" = 'over_time'
          and "recognition_schedules"."service_from" is not null and "recognition_schedules"."service_to" is not null
          and "recognition_schedules"."service_to" >= "recognition_schedules"."service_from" and "recognition_schedules"."milestone_id" is null
          and "recognition_schedules"."line_source" in ('retainer_charge', 'manual'))
        or ("recognition_schedules"."pattern" = 'point_in_time'
          and "recognition_schedules"."service_from" is null and "recognition_schedules"."service_to" is null and "recognition_schedules"."milestone_id" is not null
          and "recognition_schedules"."line_source" in ('deposit', 'milestone'))

recognition_schedules_cycle_key.name: recognition_schedules_cycle_key
recognition_schedules_cycle_key.value:
"recognition_schedules"."cycle_key" is null
        or ("recognition_schedules"."line_source" = 'retainer_charge' and char_length("recognition_schedules"."cycle_key") between 1 and 200)

reconciliation_report_events_amount.name: reconciliation_report_events_amount
reconciliation_report_events_amount.value:
("reconciliation_report_events"."currency" is null) = ("reconciliation_report_events"."amount_minor" is null)
        and ("reconciliation_report_events"."currency" is null or "reconciliation_report_events"."currency" in ('SYP', 'USD'))

reconciliation_report_events_delivery.name: reconciliation_report_events_delivery
reconciliation_report_events_delivery.value:
"reconciliation_report_events"."delivery" in ('pending', 'delivered', 'refused')
        and ("reconciliation_report_events"."refusal_code" is null or ("reconciliation_report_events"."delivery" = 'refused'
          and "reconciliation_report_events"."refusal_code" ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,63}$'))

company_exports_ready_fields.name: company_exports_ready_fields
company_exports_ready_fields.value:
("company_exports"."state" in ('ready', 'expired')) = ("company_exports"."storage_key" is not null)
        and ("company_exports"."storage_key" is null) = ("company_exports"."size_bytes" is null)
        and ("company_exports"."storage_key" is null) = ("company_exports"."sha256" is null)
        and ("company_exports"."storage_key" is null) = ("company_exports"."expires_at" is null)
        and ("company_exports"."state" = 'failed') = ("company_exports"."error" is not null)

company_exports_error_length.name: company_exports_error_length
company_exports_error_length.value: "company_exports"."error" is null or char_length("company_exports"."error") between 1 and 100
